svg.title: Fixed paint with structure off and on
svg.desc: A self-authored synthetic panel repeats identical paint geometry and colours in three columns. The reference and structure-on columns include the same hand-designed seams, fasteners, access cover and weak paired edges. Structural details can be exposed, weakened or covered.

g.data-label: Keep paint fixed while testing its surface structure
